neighbours.label: security advice about a password ('store your password securely', 'disclose your password to')
fire: Please keep your password in a safe place at all times.
Never share your password with anyone at work.
You should store your login and password securely.
Do not write your password on a sticky note.
Users must not reveal their password to other staff.
Always protect your username and password from others.
We will never ask you to send your password by email.
Remember to change your password every few months.
quiet: Please keep your receipt in a safe place at all times.
Never share your lunch with anyone at work.
You should store your milk and butter safely.
Do not write your address on a sticky note.
Users must not lend their badge to other staff.
Always protect your plants and flowers from frost.
We will never ask you to send your coat by post.
Remember to change your oil every few months.

notes: Peaks in probes fell on later tokens such as ' securely' and ' anyone'. ' Plays' of Let's Plays reached 0.36 and is not covered.
